subject: general
question:
**Direction: Given below are six sentences. A and F are the first and the last sentences. The rest of the sentences namely B, C, D and E are jumbled. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. When they reached the great city, they were frightened by the size of it and by the crowds in the streets.

B. However, they visited every street, stopping wherever they saw a crowd.

C. They were afraid they would not even recognise him, for they had not seen him for fifteen years.

D. They felt that their son would be somewhere among those people.

E. But they did not know how to find him.

F. They hoped for a chance meeting.
solution:
The correct answer is **'ADECBF.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While arranging the parts of the passage given in options, we have to find some grammatical or contextual connections between them__, so let’s find out. 

 __
 
• The opener will be A as it introduces the context of the paragraph.
 
• After this, **D** will come as it adds information about the subject **'they.'**
 
• After this, E will come as it is talking about **the way to find their son** which is mentioned in **D**.
 
• C follows E as B talks about the fear of not recognizing their son after 15 years.
 
• The last sentence will be **F** as it is providing a conclusion to the context.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is 'ADECBF.'
 
• ​​The correct sequence__:

 ​

A. When they reached the great city, they were frightened by the size of it and by the crowds in the streets.

D. They felt that their son would be somewhere among those people.

E. But they did not know how to find him.

C. They were afraid they would not even recognise him, for they had not seen him for fifteen years.

B. However, they visited every street, stopping wherever they saw a crowd.

F. They hoped for a chance meeting.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Steps for solving Para Jumbles:
 
 
• Clues include pronouns, like he, she, it, this, that, these, those; adverbs like formally, really; article a, an and the; definers like actually, finally, another; connectors like but, yet, both, also and neither nor, or, however, nevertheless.
 
• Now, with the help of clues, try to find out qualifier and qualified sentences, so that we can make pairs of qualified and qualifier sentences to eliminate the wrong choices given in the question.
 
• After making pairs, start eliminating the wrong choices or options given in the question.
 
• In case there is more than one choice, try to follow the sequence of sentences according to the occurrence of the events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

__
 
• विकल्पों में दिए गए गद्यांश के भागों को व्यवस्थित करते समय, हमें उनके बीच कुछ व्याकरणिक या प्रासंगिक संबंध खोजने होंगे, तो आइए जानें।
 
 
• Opener, A होगा क्योंकि यह पैराग्राफ के संदर्भ का परिचय देता है।
 
• इसके बाद, **D** आएगा क्योंकि यह 'वे' विषय के बारे में जानकारी जोड़ता है।
 
• इसके बाद, **E** आएगा क्योंकि यह उनके बेटे को खोजने के तरीके के बारे में बात कर रहा है जिसका उल्लेख डी में किया गया है।
 
• **C, E का अनुसरण करता है** क्योंकि B 15 साल बाद अपने बेटे को न पहचानने के डर के बारे में बात करता है।
 
• अंतिम वाक्य F होगा क्योंकि यह संदर्भ को निष्कर्ष प्रदान कर रहा है।
 
 
 
• इसलिए, अनुक्रम 'ADECBF' है।
